name: ard-discovery
description: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD v0.91 draft) for Claude Code: find MCP servers through a domain's /.well-known/ard.json and rel="ard" links, or by searching an ARD registry, which receives your query once you approve each search; mcp-server-cards checks, shows and adds them

registry.title: ARD registry for search
registry.description: Base URL of an ARD registry for ard_search to ask when the request names none (it appends /search). Empty by default: no registry is chosen for you, so each search must name one. Your query text is sent to the registry, after you approve each search.
